metadata.interpretation: NUMERICAL EVIDENCE only; no theorem status change

config.model: complete frozen reference R0, including full selected Householder/cycle feedback
config.dense_perturbation: not included; this tests the full dense reference block O_*, not the tiny actual-model transfer correction

test_1_early_capture.interpretation: Trace correction preserves the captured row up to floating-point roundoff, after expected a*g_H decay.

test_2_capture_vs_control.definition: Control_final is its unprotected COMMON-row norm, not its identically zero Walsh read. Raw ratios and normalized retained fractions are both reported.

test_3_coded_donor_scaling.definition: A small public clipped Hadamard code is a finite analogue, not the full-spark Gaussian existence lemma or a full-boundary dimension test. Coherent and one non-axis mixed boundary are measured.

test_4_intentional_break.definition: During tail/clear, the positive Walsh half is set to g_L instead of g_H. Both complete paired histories and an isolated stored zero-sum component are followed through the full O_* transport.

limits: Stationary carrier rather than long nonwrapping moving corridor
Tiny dense transfer perturbation not tested
Finite widths are outside the asymptotic theorem range
